structural_change: S81-CTRL-SVC 10-19: the 369345 gates spent 8 h in yosys OPT (4.3.x loop) on the 640x256 landing flop memory (3 runtime writes + 4 runtime reads a cycle; SYNTH_MEMORY_MAX_BITS 163840 kept it in flops). Landing -> 12 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256 (bank = row[1:0] = release lane, copy = writer PC0/PC1/ROWS, 640x2 live-value table), read at the release edge (0 cycles; SRAM read-old == flop nonblocking read), -DOT_SVC_LAND_SRAM; SYNTH_MEMORY_MAX_BITS 20480 so no >20 kb flop memory can return. PL-SVC (PARENTS-LANDED 10-18, landed-regions-standard-1018): dsdv_svc_rs_entry (entry slices rsv_05 W / rsv_11 E: the half's host endpoint; no att p store) hardened as a LANDED PARENT generated by tools/landed_parent/lp.py from the wires-only refactor dsdv_svc_rs_entry_f: 2 clock regions (c = tree region: 8 sx_hrow + 144 relay stations + tree nodes + attention share + PCs; sm = SM head: 4 smhq + smhr + smq), 8 landed crossings (532 b: SE / SM rows c -> sm, SM fault sm -> c), record results/arch/s81_dv_1016/svc_rs/lp/dsdv_svc_rs_entry_lp_record.json. Up face split up_d (done / credits / acks) + up_f (fault / rg status) so the END / done path never sees the SM fault.  Score tree / dn / up_d / P.V / HBM ports unchanged; SM face +3, up_f / hs +6, host jd / fault / st_rg +6 (hc, q, hw, j, pv 0), reset +3 (compiler record).  SVCB 10-19 (COORD 0ix (2) option (b)): the att p store is SRAM (2 even / odd banks x 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256, one-cycle static prefetch, read schedule unchanged) in the P.V owner kit
